# Phase gate checklist

## Before implementation

- [ ] Read the source brief, shared guardrails, and matching phase spec.
- [ ] Inspect the workspace and relevant existing files; preserve unrelated work.
- [ ] Confirm scope, acceptance criteria, and dependencies with the user where
      a material decision is unresolved.
- [ ] For Phase 1, report findings and proposed dependencies and wait for
      explicit approval before code changes.

## Before closeout

- [ ] Changes stay within the approved phase and respect privacy and
      calculation-integrity constraints.
- [ ] Mock outputs are unmistakably labelled; no unsupported chart facts are
      presented as real.
- [ ] Run relevant existing checks and report exact results; do not overstate.
- [ ] Review keyboard access, labels/errors, text alternatives, and responsive
      behavior for the changed surfaces.
- [ ] Complete the closeout report, list limitations, and stop for approval.
